biggest_catch: Earnings are entirely download-dependent - free-license content pays a tiny $0.005 per download, so meaningful money needs thousands of downloads.
catches: Free license: flat $5 per 1,000 downloads for vectors/photos ($0.005/download), $10 per 1,000 for videos ($0.01/download) - pay-per-download
Pro license: share of subscriber net revenue via 'subscriber share' method (variable, not a fixed rate)
Minimum payout threshold of US $25; payments approx. 45-60 days after month-end via PayPal/Payoneer
Vecteezy may withhold taxes depending on contributor country
Content must pass review; technical requirements apply (e.g., vectors in EPS format)

c1.evidence: Vecteezy (vecteezy.com) - stock vectors/photos/videos marketplace. Official contributor blog posts on vecteezy.com ('How To Make Real Money by Giving Away Free Photos', 'Free vs. Pro Content: What's the Difference?') fetched 2026-09-23.

c2.evidence: Official: 'You'll be paid $5 for every 1,000 downloads of your free files.' 'Vecteezy's Free license offers contributor's a flat rate of $5 per 1,000 downloads for vectors and photos, and a flat rate of $10 per 1,000 downloads for videos.' Pro: 'you will receive a share of the Net Revenue from that Pro Member's subscription ... calculated in accordance with the subscriber share method.'

c3.evidence: Concretely conditional: register as contributor, upload, pass review, earn per download.

c4.evidence: No entry fee; signup and uploading are free. Not pay-to-play.

eligibility: Designers, photographers, and videographers who can submit content meeting Vecteezy's technical requirements.
